metadata.title: SAE J1939 CAN-FD 29-Bit Extended Arbitration Header (0x18FEF100)
metadata.description: 32-bit aligned CAN-FD extended ID arbitration buffer decoding PGN 0xFEF1 (CCVS1) from ECM Source Address 0x00 with hardware SOF_ARB_ERR safety interlock latch.

fields.name: SOF_ARB_ERR
fields.description: Hardware arbitration / SOF framing error interlock latch. 1 = bus contention fault; write 1 to clear after LOTO bus check.

fields.name: FDF_BRS
fields.description: CAN-FD extended frame format and bit-rate switch indicator.

fields.name: IDE_EXT
fields.description: Extended Identifier mode bit in hardware mailbox shadow.

fields.name: PRIORITY
fields.description: 3-bit SAE J1939 message priority (0b110 = Priority 6 nominal powertrain status).

fields.name: EDP
fields.description: Extended Data Page selector (0 = SAE J1939 standard parameter group space).

fields.name: DP
fields.description: Data Page selector bit (0 = Page 0 PGN map).

fields.name: PF_PGN_HI
fields.description: PDU Format high byte (0xFE = 254 PDU2 broadcast group).

fields.name: PS_PGN_LO
fields.description: PDU Specific group extension low byte (0xF1 = PGN 0xFEF1 CCVS1).

fields.name: SOURCE_ADDR
fields.description: 8-bit originating node address (0x00 = Primary Engine Control Module ECM).
